precision: Official API values copied as returned; UI total 2 decimals and skills 1 decimal. No unobserved precision or scoring timestamp inferred.
identity_binding: Exact uploaded hash and browser submission ID/model/time match the authenticated receipt. Historical API team-best snapshot matched this model when available.

decision.delta_precision: approximate because candidate total is UI-rounded
decision.policy: Retain incumbent within +/-0.1; numeric team best and operational selection are separate.

limitations: Source-local diagnostics do not establish hidden-stage accuracy or causal mechanism.
Complete new-artifact disclosure does not retroactively amend older scored metadata.
